content:
emma: Heads up — ACME reported intermittent kernel oops when running CUDA 12.3 + driver 535 on our ubuntu-22.04 marketplace images. Error only when using multi-GPU context.

raj: ugh. do we have a repro container or logs?

emma: yes ACME attached logs and a small repro workload (link: https://acme.example/repro.tar.gz). stack trace shows null pointer in nvidia_uvm at unload.

oliver: I'll spin their repro on our canary rack (g4dn-like) and run the ABI smoke matrix. assigning myself.

sophia: we should decide pinning policy before rolling anything to prod marketplace. idea: canary images get driver 535-rc1 + kernel 5.15.0-101, stable images keep 535-legacy until patch.

raj: agree. also need partner signoff for driver rollback / pin on their marketplace listing. I'll draft notice.

oliver: test plan (short):
```
# smoke matrix
for KERNEL in 5.15 5.19 6.1; do
  for DRIVER in 535 534 532; do
    run_smoke --kernel $KERNEL --driver $DRIVER --repro acme_repro.tar.gz
  done
done
```
will run overnight and post results.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: marketplace-image-2026-03-20-canary -> hosts: canary-1..3

emma: action items:
- oliver: run matrix + upload results to /shared/partnerships/acme/
- raj: draft partner communication + legal check
- sophia: prepare pin rollout playbook and rollback steps

please update thread when results in. :thumbsup:

oliver: on it, kicking off job now. ETA ~10h.

sophia: drafting playbook, adding healthcheck hooks and automatic fallback to 534 if errors >5%.

raj: communication draft ready, sharing in #partnerships-drafts for review.

emma: thanks all. will convene quick sync tomorrow 10am PT if needed.
